title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Deep Sea Mutant Snake
desc: Deeply concerned about his fiancée's safety during her probe into Cass Corporation, Qin Yu seeks justice following her tragic demise. Concurrently, he challenges this immense firm.

title: Mumbai Ki Kiran Bedi
desc: When an IPS officer is killed by a criminal gang, her father meets her lookalike. He then decides to train her to be just like his daughter in order to avenge her death.

title: Aho Vikramaarka
desc: A ruthless cop unearths a sinister mystery, compelling him to confront the villainous Asura and rescue the victims held captive in his clutches.

title: Pralay the Destroyer
desc: Some thugs annihilate an entire family and flee the scene without facing any consequences. Years later, the universe balances the scales of justice through the sole survivor of the tragedy.

title: Chakra Ka Rakshak
desc: A police officer and soldier team up and decide to end the cybercriminals that pose a threat to the safety of people on the Internet.
